Help.because_it_is_still_being_worked_ou.source: Because it is still being worked out. Your meal is saved the moment you submit it, and the nutrient breakdown is estimated in the background straight afterwards — that lookup can take several seconds for a long meal. The entry updates itself when it lands, so there is nothing to re-submit. If it ends up marked as failed, edit the entry and save it again.
Help.because_it_is_still_being_worked_ou.translation: Parce qu'il est encore en cours de traitement.
